findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Subprocess with shell=True
 * @description Calling subprocess with shell=True can be dangerous if arguments are not properly sanitized.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/subprocess-shell-true
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::ArgumentNode arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
  arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
select call, "subprocess call with shell=True"
findings.hypothesis: Pip might use subprocess with shell=True, which is a common cause of command injection vulnerabilities if arguments are not properly sanitized.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command Injection with shell=True
 * @description Traces data flow from user-controlled sources (CLI args, env vars) to subprocess calls with shell=True.
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/command-injection-shell
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources

module CommandInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    // CLI arguments
    source = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("argv").getAValueReachableFromSource()
    or
    // Environment variables
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getAValueReachableFromSource()
    or
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("environ").getMember("get").getACall()
    or
    source = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("getenv").getACall()
    or
    source instanceof RemoteFlowSource
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "Popen", "run"]).getACall() and
      call.getArgByName("shell").asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true and
      (
        sink = call.getArg(0)
        or
        sink = call.getArgByName("args")
      )
    )
  }
}

module CommandInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<CommandInjectionConfig>;
import CommandInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode source, CommandInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where CommandInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential command injection from $@.", source.getNode(), "user input"
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe usage of subprocess with shell=True taking user input from CLI or Env vars.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Unsafe deserialization
 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("jsonpickle").getMember(["decode", "unpickler"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation."
findings.hypothesis: Unsafe deserialization of untrusted data leading to RCE

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE)
 * @description Parsing untrusted XML data with a weakly configured parser can lead to XXE.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember(["parse", "parseString"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember(["parse", "parseString", "make_parser"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("xmlrpc").getMember("client").getMember(["ServerProxy", "loads"]).getACall() or
  // Older python 2 names potentially used in compatibility code
  call = API::moduleImport("xmlrpclib").getMember(["ServerProxy", "loads"]).getACall()
select call, "Potential unsafe XML parsing."
findings.hypothesis: XXE vulnerability via unsafe XML parsing.
